B2_era_scale_break.note: 2026 BA fv is the Adjusted Grade; 2023-2025 fv is the BA Grade.

B3b_position_null_root_cause.finding: BA 2023-02-15 carries position NULL on 363 of 385 rows and the non-token 'CP' on the other 22 (all catchers). _is_pitcher(None) is False, so all 385 rows land in the HITTER cell. Two consequences: (1) the (baseballamerica, pitcher, 2023) cell has ZERO FanGraphs-overlap pairs, falls below _MIN_N=30 and falls back to POOLING BA ACROSS ALL YEARS, which drags the 2026 Adjusted-Grade era into the 2023-2025 BA-Grade era and re-opens the ~11.4 FV break that per-year keying exists to remove; (2) the (baseballamerica, hitter, 2023) cell is fitted on a role-MIXED distribution. The role is fully recoverable from tools_json (pitcher keys fb/sl/cb/ch/cmd/ct vs hitter keys).

outcome_vs_realized_iso_DIFFERENT_POOLS_.caveat: no realized MLB raw-power quantity exists in _TOOLS; the outcome read is indirect and the alignment read carries the weight

B5_fold_collisions.finding: the sweeper->sl and splitter->ch folds are NOT free: a pitcher graded on both members of a folded family keeps ONE canonical grade and the other observation is destroyed at ingest. Reconciles the label counts exactly: slider 606 + sweeper 48 = 654 against sl 634 (20 lost); changeup 609 + ch 6 + split 38 + splitter 5 = 658 against ch 647 (11 lost). Both are PASSTHROUGH tools, so the loss cannot be scored for accuracy, only counted.

label_to_canonical_reconciliation.cmd: control 694 + comtrol 1 = 695 == canonical cmd (the typo maps)
label_to_canonical_reconciliation.cb: curveball 402 + cb 2 = 404 == canonical cb; knuckleball 1 is DROPPED (no canonical key)
label_to_canonical_reconciliation.sl: slider 606 + sweeper 48 = 654 against canonical sl 634 -> 20 lost to fold
label_to_canonical_reconciliation.ch: changeup 609 + ch 6 + split 38 + splitter 5 = 658 against canonical ch 647 -> 11 lost to fold

B5_fold_cost.note: sl and ch are PASSTHROUGH tools with no realized MLB target (efv_tools._PASSTHROUGH), so this can only ever be a distributional comparison, never an accuracy one.

B6_league_selection.consequence: a player's number of voting sources depends on his league; all BA org boards ingested are American League clubs, so AL prospects get one more vote than NL prospects and the consensus mean is shrunk over a different denominator by league

multiplicity.note: permutation p is add-one corrected on 1000 draws, so the smallest reportable p is 0.000999
